edits.old: Then the system writes one agent_policy row in rwb_agent and no other row
edits.new:
Then the system writes one agent_policy row in rwb_agent and no other row

  Scenario: AC13 A provided operation answers 401 or 404 and reads nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller of the report operation without a valid credential
    When the caller requests the report of evaluation run "EV-INTAKE-001" through the gateway-bff route
    Then the system answers 401 and reads nothing
    Given no evaluation run matches the identifier requested
    When RW-COE requests its report through the gateway-bff route
    Then the system answers 404 and reads nothing

  Scenario: AC14 A consumed call that does not answer or fails refuses the load (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case parameters contract mock does not answer or fails inside the 2 s budget
    When RW-COE loads policy "INTAKE" version "P2" with mode "L1" and evaluation run "EV-INTAKE-001"
    Then the system refuses the load with 422 and MSG-P10-001 and writes no version row

  Scenario: AC15 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case reference-data contract mock returns LOV-CONFIG-STATUS with LOADED, APPROVED and RETIRED
    Given version "P1" has status "RETIRED"
    When user "coe.user01" approves "P1"
    Then the system refuses the change with 409 and MSG-P7-002 and the status stays "RETIRED"
    # The status changes the model allows are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P10-E1061-APP-AC12)

  Scenario: AC16 A role without the right to approve is refused with 403 and MSG-P4-002 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a user without the right to approve a version
    When that user approves version "P2"
    Then the system refuses the approval with 403 and MSG-P4-002
